name: com.openugd.corelib.widgets
description: Presenters that bind Unity uGUI widgets (Button, Text, Image, RawImage, Slider, Toggle, TMP_Text, TMP_InputField) to a model. Each presenter is handed a view it does not create, wires the Unity event callbacks when that view is attached, renders the model in an idempotent OnRefresh, and unsubscribes automatically when its Lifetime terminates. TextMeshPro text and input-field presenters are included, along with hyperlink text, gesture detection and resource-prefab presenters.

samples.description: The replacement for AddKeyboard, removed in 2.0.0: a short helper you copy into your project that calls back when a key goes down for as long as a presenter is open, and never after it closes. It reads the Input System when it is enabled and installed, otherwise the Input Manager, and otherwise does nothing.
